blocks.text: The meeting for 2028 is very intense. Although there's been a lKN, Jakarta is still much higher than the Nusantara full of controversy.
The chaos of the KIM Plus political establishment is legal. The 60 and 70 MK verdict has left Ridwan Kamil to face the fact that the chances of them winning have been significantly narrowed down.

On the other hand, the PDI-P who gets a fresh wind suddenly becomes full of political twists. Anies who still have high electrability in Jakarta, suddenly docked to PDI-P. And framing for PDI-P has to bear Anies to win over Jokowi is rolling with the gencar of the group.

A political sign that did come in. Almost the same as the second round of love, the one that Praboo-Jokowi- Gibran, that Anies (01) and Ganjar (02) got away from round one. So, this political building is a result of the 2024 election.

Demo's success of August 2223 made the spirit of change stronger and stronger. The Jokowi family and the mood of timeless political pressure have become a common enemy to pass two different poles of Anies and PDI-P.
The odds of winning through this couple exist. That's what makes the politicians miniscule.
But unlike Banten, Jakarta has a black horse called Ahok. Banten only has Airin, which is why the PDI-P gives tickets to the Airin.
There's a need to dismantle Golkar's cage in Banten. Very clear, political support in Banten.
In Jakarta, not only Ahok has high electrability, but also proved loyal to PDI-P. Plus, Ahok does have a very powerful branding on Clean, Transparent and Professional.
Therefore, the appearance of Pramono Anung's name out-of-nowhere is obviously very confusing and suspicious. It's confusing that Pramono really was filed.
Because politics, as well as idealism don't exist. Politics always counts for winning. Rate to win Pramono and Rano obviously can't compare Anies to Rano, or Ahok Ee Rano.

Curiously because why would PDI-P have to play the political spin again. What the hell makes Mrs Mega and P have to buy us until today or tomorrow. Maybe the people will never know, but what we can tell you is political, legal, and elite interests.
We need Hope

Not just political ideals, and idealism, but PDI-P and all the communities who are disappointed in Jokowi and family, as well as the current political conditions, should realize that Indonesia needs now a new direction of hope.

Jokowi personified New Hope 10 years ago killed that new hope. Pesimisme and apathy are back. As a result, the damage to nationalism's spirit is intermediate, and the new generation is going to get worse.
The image of what's in there right now is all the same. Jokowi, Prabowo, Surya Paloh, Cak Imin, PKS, and now Mega-P are the same. And it's so sad.

Ahok or BTP are the symbol of new hope that continues. That's why Indonesia needs him. By nominating him as Cagub DKJ 2024- 2029, Indonesia suddenly realized that Mega, PDlP, and Ahok were brave to keep the fire afloat hope that politics was not only for pragmatic benefit, but also for the sake of the State and Nations.
Hopefully this little writing will reach Miss Mega, and the overlords of decision at PDI-P. Give us hope again that Indonesia can still be fought for. Let the New Hope Continues!
Foot Note:
To Ahok sir, if the opportunity is given again. Give what's best for the nation and country, show them how light and salt can be for this nation. Our prayers are with us.
Pdt. Doctor. Hanny semanaga, M.B.A.
Chairman of the Christian Nationalism Forum (FORNAK)
